# Analyze history: for each frame, summarize special objects (N green, P pink, player b/Y) and S-region count
def summarize(f):
    d=f.segmentation
    info={}
    for c in ['N','P','b','Y','M','O','R']:

    info['S_count']=len(ss)

def ngreen(f): return sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')

    pts=[]

        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'):
            for p in n['boundary']: pts.append(p)

# Analyze history: for each frame, summarize special objects (N green, P pink, player b/Y) and S-region count
def summarize(f):
    d=f.segmentation
    info={}
    for c in ['N','P','b','Y','M','O','R']:
        ns=[n for n in d['nodes'] if n['color']==c]
        if ns:
            # bounding boxes
            info[c]=[(n['pixels']) for n in ns]
    # S regions: count and total pixels
    ss=[n for n in d['nodes'] if n['color']=='S']
    info['S_count']=len(ss)
    return info
print("step | N | P | player(b) | S_count")
for i,h in enumerate(history):
    s=summarize(h.frame)
    print(h.frame.step, "| N:",s.get('N'),"| P:",s.get('P'),"| b:",s.get('b'),"| S:",s.get('S_count'))

def ngreen(f): return sum(1 for n in f.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N')

    pts=[]

        if n['color'] in ('b','Y'):
            for p in n['boundary']: pts.append(p)
    return (min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)) if pts else None
